commitResults.messageBody:
- Rename chatbot from Duke to Chre
- Update Chre.java to greet user and accept input
- Display ASCII banner, greeting prompt, and farewell message
- Update documentation to reflect new chatbot name
- Add Javadoc comments to meet quality standards

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-1: Add command echo and bye exit handler
commitResults.messageBody: Update the code to echo commands entered by the user, and exit when the user types the command bye

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-2: Refactor Chre into OOP architecture with Add and List commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract functionality into focused classes following OOP principles:
- TaskList: manages task storage and retrieval
- Parser: interprets user commands ("list", "bye", or add task)
- Ui: handles all user input/output (display, prompts, messages)
- Chre: now orchestrates these components cleanly

Benefits:
- Each class has a single, clear responsibility
- Easy to extend with new features (new commands, task properties)

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-3: Add ability to mark tasks as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Task class to store completion status alongside task description:
- Task: encapsulates description and isDone status with getStatusString() for display
- TaskList: updated to manage Task objects with markTaskDone() and unmarkTaskDone()
- Parser: enhanced with getCommand() and getTaskIndex() for multi-word commands
- Ui: displays tasks with status [X] for done and [ ] for not done, with friendly feedback
- Chre: handles "mark N" and "unmark N" commands alongside existing commands

Features:
- Mark tasks as done with "mark" (shows [X] in list)
- Unmark tasks with "unmark" (shows [ ] in list)
- Parser now extracts both command and arguments separately

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java Coding Standard to project guidelines
commitResults.messageBody:
Mandate the SE-EDU Java Coding Standard (intermediate level) for all code in this project:
- Package names: all lowercase
- Class/Enum names: PascalCase
- Variable names: camelCase
- Method names: verbs in camelCase
- Constants: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE

Reference the Google Java Style Guide for topics not covered by SE-EDU standard.

This ensures consistent code quality and follows industry conventions for the entire project lifecycle.

Update AGENTS.md with detailed coding and Git standards requirements
including naming conventions, Javadoc comments, commit message format,
and branching practices. Create reusable project-specific skills for
seedu-java-coding-standard and seedu-git-standard as reference tools.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-4: Add task types and refactor task management
commitResults.messageBody:
Add new task types: Todo, Deadline, and Event with specialized behavior
and formatting. Each type properly extends Task and provides appropriate
string representation.

Rename getStatusString() to toString() to follow Java conventions and
allow standard printing idioms.

Expand Parser to handle deadline (/by) and event (/from /to) syntax.
Enhance Ui with task-specific display methods. Update TaskList with
methods to add each task type.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve code quality: reduce duplication and improve consistency
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add getLastTask() helper method to TaskList to eliminate repeated
  pattern of accessing the last added task
- Refactor Chre to use getLastTask() for cleaner, more maintainable code
- Remove unused addTask() method (marked as backwards compatibility but
  not used anywhere in the codebase)
- Fix inconsistent use of 'this' keyword in TaskList (now consistently
  uses this.tasks)

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-5: Add error handling with exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add custom ChreException class for application-specific errors
- Implement comprehensive validation in Parser methods
- Parser throws descriptive exceptions for empty descriptions
- Parser validates formats for deadline and event commands
- Parser validates task numbers and index ranges
- Add showError() method to Ui for displaying errors
- Main loop catches ChreException and displays caring error messages
- All error messages are helpful and never rude or harsh

commitResults.messageTitle: Enhance error handling for empty task list
commitResults.messageBody:
- Add check for empty task list when marking/unmarking tasks
- Provide friendly suggestion to add tasks instead of confusing error
- Improves user experience when trying to manage non-existent tasks

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge level-5: Error handling with exceptions
A-Packages: Organize classes into suitable Java packages
commitResults.messageBody:
- Create package structure: chre.ui, chre.parser, chre.task, chre.data, chre.exception
- Move Ui.java to chre.ui package
- Move Parser.java to chre.parser package
- Move Task, Todo, Deadline, Event to chre.task package
- Move TaskList.java to chre.data package
- Move ChreException.java to chre.exception package
- Move Chre.java to chre package (main entry point)
- Update all import statements for new package structure
- Maintain src/main/java as source root folder
- Follows SE-EDU Java naming conventions (all lowercase packages)
